Match reference 2's crisp pixel-art clusters, restrained dark outlines, expressive face, stylized adult proportions roughly four heads tall, defined cloth folds, warm skin shading and upper-left lighting. Preserve the reference monk's pale ivory/light gray layered robes, very wide sleeves, dark inner sleeves and gloves, reddish brown lamellar waist/hip armor panels, wrapped lower legs and dark straw sandals. Include ONE clearly recognizable naginata, a long straight dark wooden pole with a single curved steel cutting blade attached at the top; NOT a spear, NOT a katana. Body has the same apparent scale and detail as the reference battle sprite; allow extra transparent canvas height for the long weapon instead of shrinking the monk. No scenery, ground shadow, landscape, frame, text, labels, watermark, grid, additional poses, photorealism, smooth painted gradients or background. Design for final export on 288x384 transparent canvas. Subject: the MASKED monk on the RIGHT of the user's reference. Keep his gray-white cloth hood over the head, with layered scarf cloth wrapping over nose, mouth and neck, leaving only his stern eyes and brows exposed through a narrow opening. This is a cloth face covering, not a metal mask. Preserve his hood, face wrap and heavier layered white robes; no exposed mouth or hair.
